description: This file defines the NoSeekStream class which implements StreamInterface and prevents seeking operations on the underlying stream.

classes.name: NoSeekStream
classes.description: A stream decorator class that disables seeking functionality on the wrapped stream.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating that seeking is not allowed on this stream.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the stream cannot be seeked.
